name: Paul
note: "A prisoner of Christ Jesus," "Paul, the aged" (1:9), who writes with his own hand and offers to repay any debt (1:19).

name: Timothy
note: "Our brother," named with Paul in the greeting (1:1).

name: Philemon
note: "Our beloved fellow worker" (1:1), known for his love and faith (1:5) and for having refreshed the hearts of the saints (1:7). He hosts the assembly in his house.

name: Apphia
note: "The beloved Apphia" (1:2), possibly Philemon's wife or a sister in the church.

name: Archippus
note: "Our fellow soldier" (1:2); Colossians 4:17 tells him to "fulfill" the ministry he received in the Lord.

name: Onesimus
note: A slave whose name means "useful"; once "useless" to Philemon, now "useful to you and to me" (1:11). Paul calls him his child and his own heart (1:10, 1:12).

name: Epaphras
note: "My fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus" (1:23), who founded the church in Colossae (Colossians 1:7; 4:12).

name: The Lord Jesus Christ
note: In whom Paul has "all boldness," and in whom Philemon and Onesimus are now brothers.
